release.engine: Yolk สพจ. เดโม 0.1
release.engineNote: Same Yolk order and rules as branch-expansion mode (Demand → Supply → opportunity → survey queue), written as in-page JavaScript; it does not call the production engine
changes: New overview section from CityMETER: Cars: monthly registrations by vehicle type, fuel and brand for Chainat (Jan 2020–Aug 2026, province level), yearly stacked bars with a table alternative, top brands of the last 12 months, and the EV share of the last 12 months benchmarked against 77 provinces
EV charging lens and the DLT data request use the province-level CityMETER: Cars context; district and tambon registrations are still requested from DLT

district[] in data/areas.json recomputed as sums of tambons (r1 still held vehicles before integer rounding and solar-pump capacity before the W/kW fix; the page shows district names only, so on-screen numbers did not change)
Population label: CityMETER building info V4 popCount, version not stated by the endpoint (the 2026-09 label used in r1 came from another API and is withdrawn)
Wording: 'one engine' replaced by 'same order and rules as Yolk' on the page, README and meta

Independent review before publishing found 2 must-fix and 6 should-fix issues in the new section (a false 'no EVs' note on the all-types view, a charging claim labelled as a data conclusion, low-count benchmark peers, request status, EV-lens wording, 0.0% for non-zero shares, vehicle-type names, a 26-screen table on phones); all fixed and covered by scripts/qa.mjs where testable

authority.request: Owner instruction 2026-10-18: show the demo the way Yolk works, for the Provincial Energy Office mission, one product for both branch expansion and the energy office; criteria and opportunities follow the Chainat energy action plan 2566–2570 and the office mandate; publish at https://montri-th.github.io/chainat-energy/
authority.publicationBoundary: Owner decision 2026-10-18: show every field of the office registers, including names of natural persons. Implementation withholds personal phone numbers: 14 project contacts, one number inside a name field and one in an unlabelled column of the controlled-facilities file; the owner can reverse this after the office confirms consent.
authority.notAuthorised: No prices, quotations, contract terms, sales pipeline, credentials or per-site coordinates are published.
authority.carsData: Owner instruction 2026-10-18 21:39: the Department of Land Transport data in CityMETER: Cars (https://landometer.com/v3/citymeter/Central/CNT?d=cars) may be used in this demo; update the site, handoff files and product brief

observed: office registers: 203 fuel operators, 18 controlled factories and buildings, 69 projects (58 solar pumping rows with 103 systems and 360.04 kW, 1 solar PV for a cold room, 7 dryers, 2 biomass stoves, 1 biogas) with 64 photos
DLT registered vehicles by fuel, province level, as of 2026-02-28
CityMETER: Cars monthly vehicle registrations by type, fuel and brand, province level, 2020-01 to 2026-08, read 2026-10-18 from /api/v2/citymeter-v3/vehicles (data/cars.json)
CityMETER boundaries (8 districts, 53 tambons, 59 LAOs) and 177,647 building footprints
reported: electricity by PEA customer category 2566 and final energy 2566 from the action plan
proxy: CityMETER population from building info V4 popCount (version not stated by the endpoint), factories 2025-04, hotel rooms
modelled: electricity, fuel, LPG and vehicles per tambon, LAO and building
benchmark: EV (battery electric) share of new registrations in the last 12 months (2025-09 to 2026-08) across the 77 provinces (76 provinces and Bangkok) in CityMETER: Cars, passenger cars (type 1) and motorcycles (type 12), ranked high to low; Nonthaburi, Pathum Thani and Samut Prakan have implausibly low counts (fewer than 1,000 new motorcycles in 12 months) and are flagged, with Chainat's rank shown both with and without them
inference: Monthly CityMETER: Cars values are new registrations, not stock: Chainat e-motorcycles registered Jan 2020–Feb 2026 total 638, equal to the DLT stock of 638 at 28 Feb 2026; national EV registrations Oct 2022–Sep 2023 total 73,308 against 73,341 reported by DLT for fiscal 2023 (Thairath). The CityMETER: Cars page does not state the definition

visualDecisions.themes: Auto, Light and Dark from LDS foundation tokens; choice persists per browser; no first-paint flash
visualDecisions.atmosphere: Overview hero on atmosphere.measure.deep with on-deep inks; dial motif quiet variant declared on that ground; pause control before the frame
visualDecisions.identity: Governed text identity 'Landometer' in Arvo 700; no unapproved logo candidate
visualDecisions.favicon: None. The base asset registry has no approved CityMETER product tile, so no substitute is invented. LDS FAVICON-01 treats a missing icon set as a WEBFMT-01 blocker, so the page is not conformant on this point until a tile is approved
visualDecisions.choropleth: Every map metric uses the exact 41-sample LUT by mid-rank percentile, index round(40p); measured zero at index 0 with the zero outline; no-data not filled; same HEX in both themes
visualDecisions.tiers: Yolk tiers use the approved 3-class set of the activity scale (LUT indices 40, 20, 0); ไข่ขาว adds a dashed inset outline because its near-white start is close to the land colour in light theme; opportunity candidates (ชวนสำรวจ) add a heavy inset outline
visualDecisions.families: activity for energy use, count for register counts, density-household for per-household electricity
visualDecisions.selection: Map selection uses map.selectedStroke and a marker with markerHalo/markerStroke; data fills never change colour on selection
visualDecisions.navigation: No decorative brackets or coloured left rails; visible keyboard focus; 44 px direct targets
visualDecisions.queue: Yolk vocabulary and eligibility: only Demand members (tier 1–3) enter the queue; statuses ชวนสำรวจ / ต้องเพิ่มหลักฐาน / ยังไม่พบสัญญาณ; release stamp shows the criteria preset name
visualDecisions.categories: Fuel categories in the vehicle chart use landometer-series-10-v8 soft fills (DATAVIZ-05) through --ldm-series-NN-fill-light/dark tokens, theme-specific as LDS defines; stable slots and cues: diesel 01 circle, gasoline 02 square, hybrid 03 triangle, plug-in hybrid 04 diamond, electric 05 cross; every segment has a 1px border.default edge; legend shows the shape cue; a table alternative and an aria label per bar carry the numbers

knownLimitations: Demand per area and per building is modelled from province totals until PEA, fuel-sales and DLT linkages are in place
CityMETER: Cars is province level only; it gives the trend and mix of new registrations, not the vehicles or charging demand of a tambon
Office registers carry no data date and no coordinates
Shortlist is stored in the viewer's browser only
Static demo: no authentication, database or live connection to CityMETER production
